name: Hyderabadi Dum Biryani
subtitle: Kachchi biryani: raw marinated mutton layered under rice and sealed from the start

ingredients.note: only seals the lid and is discarded, so the dish stays gluten-free

prepNotes: Kachchi means raw: the mutton goes in uncooked and must finish in the same time as the rice. That only works with a long marination and a tender cut.
Marinate at least 6 hours, ideally overnight. This is the single biggest determinant of success.

steps.text: Marinate the mutton with yogurt, ginger, garlic, chilli, turmeric, garam masala, half the birista, half the herbs, lemon juice and salt. Refrigerate 6 hours or overnight.
Bring the marinated meat to room temperature and spread it in a heavy pot with 3 tbsp ghee.
Boil the rice in well-salted water with the whole spices until 70% done, then drain immediately.
steps.tip: A firm core in the grain. It finishes on dum.

steps.text: Layer the rice over the raw meat. Top with the remaining birista, herbs, saffron milk and ghee.
Seal with a dough rope or tight foil. Cook on high for 5 minutes to build steam, then on the lowest heat for 45 minutes.
Rest 15 minutes before opening. Serve with mirchi ka salan and dahi chutney.

storage: Keeps 2 days refrigerated. Reheat covered with a splash of water. The rice suffers in the freezer.
